context: Procedural terrain controls: passes are mountain routes, reach is stream length, and banks/bars are terrain, not finance/weapons.

entries.source: Adds lava and ember fields to the map editor. Ground units cannot enter them; flying units crossing them lose health quickly. Projectiles pass over.
Adds loam, moss and spring meadows to the map editor. They support buildings and crops and irrigate the land around them more strongly than water does.
Adds deep and dark water to the map editor. Swimmers cross them more slowly, no algae grows in them, and they still irrigate nearby fields.
Adds holes and chasms to the map editor. Nothing can cross them, not even flying units, and projectiles stop at their edge.
Pick a brush. Groups share one set of rules; their members differ only in look.
Pick a brush. More terrain groups appear here once their experiments are enabled under Settings > Experiments.
